name: ICS/OT Network Security
description: Deprecated: superseded by ICSIOT-ICS-NETWORK. Ability to assess the security of industrial control system (ICS) and operational technology (OT) networks. Covers understanding of ICS/SCADA protocols (Modbus, DNP3, OPC, EtherNet/IP), Purdue model assessment, IT/OT boundary security, and safe assessment techniques that avoid disrupting operational processes.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to ICS/OT network security assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands ICS/OT concepts, the Purdue model, and why OT environments require specialized assessment approaches
evidence: Can explain the Purdue model and ICS network architecture layers
Understands common ICS protocols (Modbus, DNP3, OPC UA, EtherNet/IP)
Knows why ICS/OT environments require extreme caution during assessment

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Performs basic ICS/OT network assessment tasks under strict supervision
evidence: Identifies ICS/OT devices and protocols on the network using passive techniques
Reviews IT/OT boundary configurations and firewall rules under guidance
Uses ICS-safe scanning techniques in controlled lab environments
Documents findings with awareness of OT operational constraints under review

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses ICS/OT network security with appropriate safety controls
evidence: Performs comprehensive IT/OT boundary security assessment
Identifies protocol-level vulnerabilities in ICS communications
Assesses Purdue model compliance and zone segregation effectiveness
Produces ICS/OT-specific assessment reports with safety-aware recommendations

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Assesses complex ICS/OT environments; develops safe assessment tools; mentors others
evidence: Assesses diverse ICS environments across different industries and protocols
Develops ICS-safe scanning and enumeration tools and procedures
Evaluates ICS protocol security at the packet level using Wireshark and custom parsers
Mentors junior staff on safe ICS/OT assessment methodology

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines ICS/OT assessment methodology; publishes research; trains teams
evidence: Authored the lab's ICS/OT network security assessment methodology
Published research on ICS protocol vulnerabilities or assessment techniques
Deep expertise across multiple ICS/SCADA platforms and protocols
Trains teams on ICS/OT network security assessment and safe testing practices

assessment_methods.description: Assess IT/OT boundary security and ICS protocol security in a lab ICS environment without disrupting simulated operational processes
Review ICS/OT assessment reports from recent engagements for safety compliance and technical accuracy

equipment: ICS/SCADA lab environment with representative PLCs and HMIs
